Welcome to 325 15th St NW, an award-winning historic Craftsman in Canton’s Vassar Park neighborhood, where more than a century of architectural character has been beautifully preserved while thoughtful updates bring modern-day comfort! From the moment you enter, the craftsmanship commands your attention. Original white oak flooring, rich red oak trim, beveled glass doors, glass doorknobs, original light fixtures and beautiful French doors are just a few of the details that give this 1916 home its unmistakable personality. The main level was made for gathering. A grand living room offers impressive space for entertaining, while the oversized formal dining room provides the perfect setting for holidays, dinner parties and everyday memories. French doors connect the spaces beautifully, and the kitchen continues the home’s historic appeal with a distinctive pressed ceiling and generous workspace. Upstairs, you’ll find four spacious bedrooms each with ample closet space and a full bath. The third floor offers even more living space and flexibility! Ideal for a home office, studio, recreation area or whatever fits your lifestyle. While the historic details are truly a work of art, the current owners have made a significant investment in the home’s comfort and functionality. Approximately $25,000 has recently been invested to upgrade the heating system and the addition of air conditioning throughout the home! Outside, you'll appreciate the fully fenced yard and flagstone patio. The garage even tells a story, featuring soaring ceilings and distinctive wooden carriage-style doors.  If you’ve been waiting for a home with character, space and a story all its own, this is one!  With close proximity to schools, parks, shopping, dining and more - this is one you will want to see in person! Call your favorite agent today!
